mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month signals monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 3.8% signals labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of months when UNRATE exceeds 3.8%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 108.0) signals an early recession phase, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when INDPRO < 108.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A rising quarterly GDP (GDPC1) indicates economic expansion, which correlates with positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of quarters when GDPC1 rises, or the Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 3.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of months when CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) combined with a stable or rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates dual economic stress, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when UNRATE rises and FEDFUNDS is stable or rising, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 4.0%), a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of months when UNRATE rises by >0.2pp and CPIAUCSL > 4.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
